result.summary: This is a typical residential mid-block environment with row houses and a continuous sidewalk. While a sidewalk is present, it is relatively narrow and contains obstructions such as signage and stairs, and parked vehicles along the curb create visual barriers between the walkway and the roadway.

hazards.description: A continuous line of parked cars obscures the view between pedestrians on the sidewalk and drivers in the roadway, particularly dangerous near the bus stop.

interventions.title: Bus Bulb-out
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the bus stop to improve pedestrian waiting space and visibility.

interventions.title: Daylighting

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting to improve visibility and safety for pedestrians during evening hours.
